function.description: Set a spender's allowance to ZERO. Use after a swap so no standing claim on the wallet survives the trade. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_revoke_approval

chain.description: Chain to revoke on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE simulates only. Set false to sign.

spender.description: Address whose allowance is set to ZERO (0x…)
